name: Cable Pull-Through
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley, straddle the cable facing away, and hold an end in each hand.
Walk forward a couple of steps into a shoulder-width stance so the cable pulls taut between your legs.
Push your hips straight back with soft knees and a flat back as your hands travel between your thighs.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall while keeping your arms straight.
tips: Keep your knees soft and finish with your ribs stacked over your hips.
Let your arms stay relaxed and straight instead of pulling the rope up with your shoulders.
